They will periodically wake the phone and record the following:

  1. Which cell towers you phone can see. The more towers the more precise your location.

  2. Which WIFI SSIDs it can observe. This alone can accurately locate you.

  3. Which Bluetooth devices it can detect. This enhances location accuracy if there are any "beacon" devices available. Because of it's short range this can place your location with high accuracy.

  4. If AGPS data is available it is used.

  5. If GPS data is available is is used.

They cache this information. Once the device is awake by user control it then transmits all of the cached data to Google.

Full disclosure: It has been many years since I last looked at the code and much logic has been rewritten. Some of this may no longer be true. I fully expect it is still true and improved.
